dagmm.recon_loss: per-sample squared L2 error ||x - x'||^2, summed over entries, mean over the batch (Zong et al. 2018, Eq. 7)

revision.cross_federation_design: one model per configuration, trained on the honest innovations of every client in rounds 12-35 of CAL seeds 0 and 1, scored on every seed; headline over the other seeds
revision.why_invalid: each seed is an independently trained federation (own initialisation, own client models), so prototype spaces share no coordinates and a density model of one federation's raw innovations does not transfer to another. Honest rows only, rounds 12-35, seeds 0-2: the top 10 principal components fitted on one seed explain 0.018-0.066 of another seed's variance (CIFAR-100 0.5 and CIFAR-10), against 0.72-0.74 for odd rounds of the same seed fitted on its even rounds; cosines between seeds' mean innovations are -0.021 to 0.035; on the held-out honest rows, predicting zero (0.995 / 0.939 / 0.972 per entry) beats predicting the CAL mean (1.051 / 1.017 / 1.036). The low held-out reconstruction quality was first attributed to memorisation; it is the absence of shared coordinates.
revision.inspected: the attacked AUCs of both runs had been computed and read before the within-federation design was fixed; that design was fixed on honest data only (rows of the seed's own rounds 2-11 and 12-35) before any attacked payload was scored with it; afterwards a code-path smoke test with 8 Adam steps (CIFAR-10) printed AUCs of an essentially untrained model, which were not used for anything

v1.recon_loss: ((x - x')^2).mean() over batch and entries, i.e. the per-sample squared L2 error divided by D (12,800 at CIFAR-100, 1,280 at CIFAR-10)

v2.recon_loss: as DAGMM.recon_loss; 200 epochs on 480 rows (3,000 Adam steps)

revision.within_design_budget: fixed at 3,000 Adam steps after an honest-only pilot on CAL seed 0 (rounds 2-11 for training, 12-35 for the check): at 200 epochs (800 steps) the reconstruction error per entry on the training rows was 0.995 (CIFAR-100 0.5) and 1.023 (CIFAR-10) against 0.871 and 0.791 for the training mean; at 3,000 steps 0.847 and 0.800
